a.text: I'll keep our agreement and operate in round 1. One concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, we'll probably not reach 8 cells before a storm hits. Reaching 8 takes two rounds of operating, then a round to take. If you see a fairer way to handle that risk, say so openly and we can agree on a change together. Until then I'm sticking to the plan and won't take early.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Once the reserve hits 8, we each take 4.
